apply.branchHint: A new branch, made from the tip of the branch the clone is read from. It must not exist yet. Leave it blank for {{name}}.
apply.confirmPushPr: Commit, push and open pull request
apply.openPrNote: Into the branch the commit was made on top of.
apply.optionLocal: Commit to a new branch in the local clone
apply.optionPr: Open a pull request on GitHub
apply.prDesc: Creates a new branch in the repository, commits the files and opens a pull request. Nothing is pushed to the default branch.
apply.prDescFiles: Creates a new branch in the repository, commits {{files}} and opens a pull request. Nothing is pushed to the default branch.
apply.pushNote: Pushes with the repository's stored credential, to its GitHub address only. The folder's own remotes and git settings are not used. If the push fails the commit stays and you can retry.
apply.title: Apply this change set?
changes.caption: Change sets of {{name}}
changes.emptyDescription: A change set is the only way text reaches this repository. Edit the listing to create a draft; an admin or owner approves it, then applies it as a pull request or as a commit on a new branch of the local clone.
changes.loadFailed: Could not load the change sets.
choice.noteConfirm: The clone’s origin is {{origin}}, a different repository. Attach only if it is a fork or mirror of this one.
choice.noteConfirmReplaces: The clone’s origin is {{origin}}, a different repository. Attach only if it is a fork or mirror of this one. Replaces its current local clone ({{path}}).
choice.noteLocalOnly: No GitHub connection: the folder is the repository. Pull requests are not available for it yet.
choice.noteRecommended: The clone’s origin points at this repository. Applying still opens a pull request on GitHub.
choice.noteRecommendedReplaces: The clone’s origin points at this repository. Applying still opens a pull request on GitHub. Replaces its current local clone ({{path}}).
clone.description: A cache of the repository, so scans and listings do not download it every time.
clone.freeFailed: The clone could not be removed. Try again.
clone.lookFailed: Could not look at the clone.

connect.alreadyConnected: {{name}} is already connected to this workspace.
connect.authHint: GitHub did not accept this credential. Test it on the Credentials screen, or replace its secret.
connect.badOwner: “{{owner}}” is not a GitHub user or organization name.
connect.badRepo: “{{repo}}” is not a GitHub repository name.
connect.chooseCredentialError: Choose the credential to connect with.
connect.credentialGone: That credential no longer exists. Pick another one.
connect.credentialKind: Only a GitHub App or a GitHub token can connect a repository.
connect.description: Nothing is changed in the repository until you approve a change set.
connect.forbiddenHint: The credential cannot read {{name}}. For a GitHub App, check that it is installed on {{owner}} and that {{repo}} is selected under Repository access. For a token, check that it covers this repository and has read access to its contents.
connect.localFailed: Could not load the local clone settings.
connect.noCredentialBody: Add a GitHub App or a GitHub token on the <link>Credentials</link> screen, then come back to connect a repository.
connect.notFoundHint: Check the spelling of {{name}}. GitHub also answers this way for a private repository that the credential cannot see, so confirm that the App or token has access to it.
connect.repositoryHint: Owner and name, such as acme/mobile-app. You can also paste the GitHub address.
connect.title: Connect a repository
connect.useForm: Use the form owner/name, for example acme/mobile-app.

detail.leaveBody: You have edited listing text that is not in a change set yet. Leaving discards those edits.

diag.unusedTitle: Folders that look like metadata but were not used
diff.caption: Line by line changes in {{path}}
diff.lineEndsOnly: Only line endings or the newline at the end of the file changed.
fixup.failed: The fix up did not work. Try again.
fixup.fromStore: Take the text from the live store listing
fixup.fromStoreHint: Makes the pull again from the store snapshot and the repository as they are now, and adds what changed.
fixup.githubNote: The commit is added through the GitHub API as a fast-forward and the pull request follows the branch. If the pull request is closed or merged, nothing is written.
fixup.historyBody: Commits and edits that other people made on the branch stay; a change in the same place as yours is shown to you and you choose.
fixup.intro: The branch {{branch}} already exists. A fix up reads the repository again, works out what the branch is missing, and adds the difference as a new commit on top of the branch.
fixup.localNote: The commit is made in the local clone without touching its checked out branch or working folder. It is signed with the server's key when the server signs commits, like the first one. If the branch is checked out in the clone, the fix up is refused.
fixup.needChoiceBody: Nothing has been written. For each file choose to keep your text or the other one. After that, check again.
fixup.noPr: There is no pull request for this branch yet; it is opened with the commit.
fixup.openPrHint: There is none yet. It needs the push.
fixup.previewTitle: What the new commit would hold
fixup.pushHint: A normal push, never forced. If the branch on GitHub has other commits, the commit stays local and you are told.
fixup.signed: The commit is signed with the server's key.
fixup.title: Fix up this branch
fixup.wouldWrite: What the fix up would write (mine)
kind.summaryBoth: Both fastlane and Expo files were found. The App Store listing comes from store.config.json when there is one (the fastlane App Store files are then ignored); the Google Play listing comes from fastlane.
kind.summaryExpo: An Expo project. Its App Store listing is read from and edited in store.config.json when the repository has one. Google Play listing text lives in fastlane only.
kind.summaryFastlane: A fastlane project. Store listing text is read from the metadata folders and changes are applied as a pull request, or as a commit on a new branch of a local clone.
kind.summaryUnknown: No fastlane or Expo files were found. Check that this is the right repository and that the credential can read all of it.
lc.branchHint: Only committed work on this branch is read. The folder’s own checkout is not changed.
lc.branchesFailed: Could not list the branches of the folder.
lc.checkFailed: Could not check the folder. Try again.
lc.descGithub: Reads can come from a clone on the server instead of GitHub. Pull requests still go to GitHub.
lc.descLocalOnly: This repository is a folder on the server. It has no GitHub connection.
lc.detachBody: {{name}} is read from GitHub again. The folder {{path}} is not changed or deleted.
lc.detachFailed: Could not detach the local clone.
lc.detached: Detached the local clone. The folder was not changed.
lc.modalDescription: Reads come from the committed files of a git folder on the server. Applying still opens a pull request on GitHub.
lc.noneAttached: No local clone is attached. This repository is read from GitHub.
lc.title: Local clone
lc.untilGithub: Until then this repository is read from GitHub.
lc.untilLocalOnly: Until then this repository cannot be read.
lcc.branchHint: Only the committed tip of this branch is read, never the files you are editing.
lcc.confirmMismatch: The origin is a different repository. It is a fork or mirror of this one, and I want to attach it anyway.
lcc.detachedBody: HEAD is detached in this folder, so there is no current branch. Pick the branch to read.
lcc.disabledNote: Only the person who runs the server can change it: it decides which folders this tool may ever read.
lcc.existing: This folder is already used by {{name}}. Open that repository to change it.
lcc.existingLocalOnly: This folder is already used by {{name}} (local-only). Open that repository to change it.
lcc.localOnlyBody: The tool reads it and builds change sets from the committed files. There is no GitHub repository to open a pull request on, so a change set is applied as a commit on a new branch of the folder, which you merge yourself. That needs KILN_LOCAL_REPO_WRITE=true on the server.
lcc.localOnlyTitle: What a local-only repository can do
list.caption: Connected repositories
list.confirmBlocked: A repository with a draft, approved or applying change set cannot be disconnected.
list.confirmGithub: {{name}} will be removed from this workspace, together with its finished change sets. The repository on GitHub is not changed.
list.confirmGithubLocal: {{name}} will be removed from this workspace, together with its finished change sets. The repository on GitHub and the local folder are not changed.
list.confirmLocalOnly: {{name}} will be removed from this workspace, together with its finished change sets. The folder {{path}} is not changed or deleted.
list.githubAria: {{name}} on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
listing.emptyExpo: No listing text was found at {{appStore}} (App Store, no apple.info locales) or {{googlePlay}} (Google Play). Fastlane keeps one folder per locale with a text file per field; Expo keeps the App Store text in store.config.json under apple.info. Run a scan to see what the project contains.
listing.emptyFastlane: No listing text was found at {{appStore}} (App Store) or {{googlePlay}} (Google Play). Fastlane keeps one folder per locale with a text file per field; Expo keeps the App Store text in store.config.json under apple.info. Run a scan to see what the project contains.
listing.readNotice: The store listing is read from GitHub with the stored credential, which needs the member role or higher. As a viewer you can see the project and the change sets, but not the listing text. Ask an admin if you need access.
listing.sourceProblem: {{error}} The listing cannot be shown or changed until the file is fixed in the repository.
local.controlChars: The path must not contain control characters.
local.disabledBody: Set {{envName}}=/Volumes/dev (a colon-separated list of the folders that may hold your clones) and restart the server.
local.gitMissingTitle: git is not available on the server
local.latestBranchClean: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}. The folder has no uncommitted changes.
local.latestBranchDetached: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}. The folder has a detached HEAD checked out; only committed work on {{branch}} is read.
local.latestBranchDirty_one: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}; {{count}} uncommitted change is not included.
local.latestBranchDirty_other: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}; {{count}} uncommitted changes are not included.
local.latestBranchOther: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}. The folder has {{checkedOut}} checked out; only committed work on {{branch}} is read.
local.latestBranchUncountable: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes are never read (they could not be counted).
local.latestBranchUnknown: Reads the latest commit on branch {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes in the folder are never read.
local.offReadsApiBody: KILN_READS=api means git is never run, so local clones cannot be read.
local.pathAbsolute: Use an absolute path, such as /Volumes/dev/my-app. “~” is not expanded.
local.pathEmpty: Enter the path of a folder on the server.
local.rootsMany: The folder must be inside one of the allowed folders: {{roots}}.
local.rootsNone: The folder must be inside an allowed folder on the server.
local.rootsOne: The folder must be inside the allowed folder: {{roots}}.
local.shaBranchClean: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}. The folder has no uncommitted changes.
local.shaBranchDetached: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}. The folder has a detached HEAD checked out; only committed work on {{branch}} is read.
local.shaBranchDirty_one: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}; {{count}} uncommitted change is not included.
local.shaBranchDirty_other: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}; {{count}} uncommitted changes are not included.
local.shaBranchOther: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}. The folder has {{checkedOut}} checked out; only committed work on {{branch}} is read.
local.shaBranchUncountable: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes are never read (they could not be counted).
local.shaBranchUnknown: Reads commit {{sha}} on branch {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes in the folder are never read.

lp.formHintEdited_other: {{count}} fields edited. Nothing is written until an admin or owner approves the draft and applies it, as a pull request or as a commit on a new branch of the local clone.

page.connectedLocal: Connected {{name}} as a local-only repository. Scan it to see what it contains.
page.description: The fastlane or Expo projects your listing text is read from. Changes go back as pull requests that a person approves.
page.emptyRead: An admin or owner connects repositories. Once one is connected it appears here.
page.emptyWrite: Connect your app’s GitHub repository or a clone on the server. Nothing is written without an approved change set.
page.noAccess: Your role does not include repositories.
page.title: Repositories
project.emptyRead: Nobody has scanned this repository yet. A member, admin or owner can scan it.
project.emptyWrite: A scan lists the files in the repository and works out whether it uses fastlane, Expo or both. It only reads.
project.evidenceCaption: Files that led to the detected project type
project.evidenceHint: Confirmed means a file states it. Likely is a reasonable reading and never changes the detected type.
project.evidenceNone: No files that point to fastlane or Expo were found.
project.expoDescription: Read from app.json and eas.json. Nothing is run.
project.expoDynamic: The Expo config is a script, so name, version and identifiers cannot be read without running it.
project.foundDescription: Folders and files the scan used.
project.scanningHint: Reading the file list from GitHub. This can take a few seconds.
project.storeConfigDynamic: {{path}} (a script, so its text cannot be read)
recompute.approved: This change set is approved. If the text changes, the approval is cleared.
recompute.failed: The recompute did not work. Try again.
recompute.intro: This change set was made by pulling the store listing. Recomputing makes the pull again from the store listing as it is now, against the repository as it is now, and replaces the files of this change set.
recompute.lastListing: The last listing read from the store is used. Someone who may sync the app can read it again first.
recompute.point1: The change set keeps its id and its author. Nothing is written to the repository.
recompute.point2: Fields the store changed since are updated, and fields the repository has caught up on leave the change set.
recompute.point3: It becomes a draft again and has to be approved again.
recompute.refreshFirstHint: Reads the listing from the store now (read only, the same read a sync makes) instead of using the last one.
recompute.storeError: The store could not be read ({{error}}), so the last listing read was used.
recompute.title: Recompute from the live store
refresh.approved: This change set is approved. If a refresh changes its text it becomes a draft again and has to be approved again.
refresh.baseSummary: The version your change was made from
refresh.conflictBody: Choose for each file. Keep mine overwrites what the repository has with your text. Keep theirs drops your change to that file. Nothing has been changed yet.
refresh.conflictTitle_one: One file changed in the same place
refresh.conflictTitle_other: {{count}} files changed in the same place
refresh.failed: The refresh did not work. Try again.
refresh.intro: The repository changed after this change set was made. Refreshing reads the files again and puts your change on top of what is there now.
refresh.point1: Files that did not change stay as they are.
refresh.point2: Files whose change is already in the repository leave the change set.
refresh.point3: Files that changed in another place are merged line by line.
refresh.point4: Files that changed in the same place are shown to you, and you choose. Nothing is changed until you do.
refresh.title: Refresh this change set
review.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
review.applyingBody: Creating the branch and committing the files. This page checks again every few seconds.
review.approvedToast: Approved. It can now be applied.
review.discardBody: {{summary}} will be closed without changing the repository. This cannot be undone; you can make a new change set from the listing.
review.discardedToast: Change set discarded. The repository was not changed.
review.failedBranch: A branch named {{branch}} was created before the failure; delete it in GitHub if you do not need it.
review.failedDiscard: Discard this change set and create a new one from the current listing.
review.failedFixup: The branch exists, so it cannot be refreshed. Fix it up to add one commit on top of the branch (history is not rewritten), or discard this change set and create a new one from the current listing.
review.failedRefresh: Refresh it to put your change on top of what the repository has now, or discard it and create a new one from the current listing.
review.finishedToast: The change set finished. Check its status.
review.fixupLocal_one: {{count}} file, <link>{{ago}}</link>, in the local clone only
review.fixupLocal_other: {{count}} files, <link>{{ago}}</link>, in the local clone only
review.fixupsAdded_one: One fix up commit was added to the branch since.
review.fixupsAdded_other: {{count}} fix up commits were added to the branch since.
review.fixupsTitle: Fix ups (commits added on top of the branch, oldest first)
review.loadFailed: Could not load the change set.
review.localBlockedTitle: Committing to a branch is not possible yet
review.noFiles: This change set has no files.
review.onlyAdminApply: Only an admin or owner can apply a change set.
review.onlyAdminApprove: Only an admin or owner can approve a change set.
review.prOpenLink: <link>{{label}}</link>. Review and merge it in GitHub; nothing was pushed to the default branch.
review.pushedPrToast: The branch is on GitHub and the pull request is open.
review.reviewMerge: Review and merge it in GitHub.
root.badChars: The path must not contain backslashes or control characters.
root.badSegment: The path must not contain empty, "." or ".." segments.
root.empty: Enter a folder path inside the repository.
root.gitFolder: The path must not point into .git.
root.leadingSlash: The path must be relative to the repository, without a leading slash.
root.tooLong: The path is too long (at most 300 characters).
stale.askHint: Someone who can create change sets can refresh it.
stale.changed: The repository changed after this change set was made, so applying it would not match the files.
stale.checkFailed: Could not check the repository. Try again.
stale.recomputeHint: Makes this pull again from the store listing and the repository as they are now.
stale.refreshHint: Refresh it to put your change on top of what is there now, instead of starting over.
stale.title: This change set is out of date
status.appliedHint: The pull request is open. Merge it in GitHub.
status.applyingHint: Creating the branch and the pull request.
status.approvedHint: Approved. It can be applied as a pull request or as a commit on a new branch of the local clone.
status.draftHint: Waiting for an admin or owner to approve it.
status.failedHint: The change did not reach the repository.

tgt.appIdHint: The bundle id or package name, for your own reference.
tgt.description: Where the store listing of {{name}} lives. A folder you set here is always used instead of the detected one.
tgt.iosHint: The folder that holds the locale folders (en-US, de-DE, ...), relative to the repository. Leave empty if this target has no App Store listing.
